newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's TAP seen posting profit in '97.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's TAP seen posting profit in '97.

text.p: Portuguese airline TAP-Air Portugal is likely to post a profit this year for the first time since 1973 and to be privatised in the second half of 1998, Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos said.
He told reporters it was possible that the state may relinquish its majority holding in TAP, depending on future strategic partnerships.
"The board of TAP has communicated to the government the good results that are being achieved this year. TAP has forecast that it could pull out of the red and post a profit in 1997," he said.
"The objective will be privatisation in 1998, but I doubt that it will be possible in the first half of that year," he added.

"The intention of the state is to maintain 51 percent of TAP," he said. But he said that after a detailed review of possible strategic partners, "this scenario (sale of more than 51 percent) cannot be ruled out."
